definitions.explanation: Not difficult to do or understand. Written as {易|やさ}しい. The opposite of {難|むずか}しい.
Having a mild or caring disposition. Written as {優|やさ}しい.

examples.japanese: この{本|ほん}は{易|やさ}しい{日本語|にほんご}で{書|か}かれています。
examples.english: This book is written in easy Japanese.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}はとても{優|やさ}しい{人|ひと}です。
examples.english: She is a very kind person.

examples.japanese: {優|やさ}しく{教|おし}えてください。

notes: Two different meanings with different kanji: {易|やさ}しい (easy) vs {優|やさ}しい (kind/gentle). Context usually makes the meaning clear. Both are i-adjectives with the same conjugation.
